message: So, my friend Jamie is the one who always panics when I mention fire safety. I remember last summer, we were grilling in the backyard, and she suddenly started asking if we had a fire extinguisher nearby. I couldn’t help but laugh a little because, let’s be real, we were just making burgers! But it got me thinking—having a plan in place, whether it’s knowing where the extinguishers are or having an escape route, really does take the edge off. 😌 I guess it’s her way of keeping us all safe, and I appreciate that. What about you? Do you have a fire plan in place?
